title: Intermational Guides Bureau - Aplications For Passports Received From Russian Emigrants

page_data.en:
F.M.
G. 45M-1-36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No...........

REPORT
S.1, Special Branch
Date June 28, 1937.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH POLICE No. 2783/ Date 29. 6. 37）

Subject International Guides Bureau - further report.

Made by D.S. Larby, Forwarded by A. Laing

Further to Special Branch report, dated 10/6/37,
a list of the male applicants for employment as guides and
escorts in the International Guides Bureau is attached herewith.
Included in this list are the names of the
following persons, each of whom has come to the notice of
the Municipal Police:-

1. H. Hansen, 51, Danish, residing at 70, Wayside
Road. This individual was strongly suspected of being concerned
in the operation of a roulette wheel at 9A Hankow Road during
the year, 1927. He is also known to the Municipal Police as
having dealt in firearms and on the 9/10/33, he was brought
before the Danish Consul-General when he was sentenced to 14
days imprisonment with the alternative of paying a fine of
$100.00. (Files, G.F. 37/1927 and L. Misc. 449/1933).
（批：Send?）

2. A.S. Kleinerman, 39, Russian, residing at 343,
King Albert Apartments, Apartment No.5; this individual has
been reported to be a Soviet Agent. Since 1921, however, his
activities appear to have been confined to the operating of
various confectionery establishments and restaurants. (File
L.A.B. 33/1539).

3. A.A. Mihailoff, 27, Russian, residing at 67
Ru Pere Robert: from April 1931 to October 1935, Mihailoff was
in the employ of the Compagnie Francaise de Tramways et d'Eclairage
de Shanghai from where, it is reported, he was dismissed for
having failed to render a complete account of certain monies
which he had collected on behalf of the Company. He is
described by an acquaintance as being a pleasure loving young
man with a tendency to live beyond his means. (File D. 6816).
（批：Could be established as a concubine fact）

4. Carl Lemcke, 38, American residing at Lane 30,

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号...........

报告
S.1，特科
日期：1937年6月28日。
（印：特科警察第2783号/ 日期 37.6.29）

事由：国际导游局——进一步报告。

由 D.S. Larby 撰写，由 A. Laing 转呈

继1937年6月10日的特科报告之后，现附上在国际导游局申请担任导游和陪同人员的男性申请人名单。
该名单中包含以下人员的姓名，他们均曾引起工部局警务处的注意：-

1. H. Hansen，51岁，丹麦人，住威赛德路（Wayside Road）70号。此人被强烈怀疑在1927年间参与汉口路9A号的轮盘赌经营。工部局警务处还知晓其从事枪支交易，并于1933年10月9日被带至丹麦总领事面前，被判监禁14天，或选择缴纳100.00美元罚款。（档案，G.F. 37/1927 和 L. Misc. 449/1933）。
（批：发送？）

2. A.S. Kleinerman，39岁，俄国人，住金阿尔伯特公寓（King Albert Apartments）343号5室；据报此人为苏联特工。然而，自1921年以来，他的活动似乎仅限于经营各类糖果店和餐馆。（档案 L.A.B. 33/1539）。

3. A.A. Mihailoff，27岁，俄国人，住罗伯神父路（Rue Pere Robert）67号：从1931年4月至1935年10月，Mihailoff 受雇于上海法商电车电灯公司（Compagnie Francaise de Tramways et d'Eclairage de Shanghai），据报他因未能就其代表公司收取的某些款项提供完整账目而被解雇。一位熟人形容他是一个爱享乐的年轻人，有入不敷出的倾向。（档案 D. 6816）。
（批：可确立为包养情妇的事实）

4. Carl Lemcke，38岁，美国人，住西摩路（Seymour Road）30弄，

House 8, Seymour Road: this person is the individual who in
conjunction with Brian Naidis endeavoured to effect the
release of Walden - a notorious communist - in Hankow in 1935.
(Files D.6423, D.6704A, C.8255, E.1680).

5. Alex Becker, 32, Latvian, residing at House 23,
1295, Rue Lafayette: there is every reason to assume that the
above named is identical with Alexander Leonidovich Pecker,
alias A.L.Becker, Russian Jew, born 28/3/1904. At various
times Pecker is reported to have been concerned in a number of
transactions appertaining to the sale of firearms. In 1934
Pecker was employed in the Tsingtao branch of the China Travel
Service during which period he was suspected by the Tsingtao
Police of being concerned in the theft of a diamond ring and,
furthermore, of writing a threatening letter. After his
return to Shanghai in the latter part of 1934 Pecker was noted
by the Boarding House Section as having absconded from a
boarding house situated at 71 Wayside Road. Recently, Pecker
has come to the notice of the French Police as a drug addict.
His appearance, however, belies his liking for narcotics and
to most people he gives the impression of being an extremely
worldly man possessed of a boastful nature. (File D.19)

While the above named five persons are actually the
only individuals included in this list of applicants who,
according to the files of the Municipal Police, have anything
detrimental to their names, the remainder do not appear to be
of a particularly good type and it would appear that a watch
on the activities of the International Guides Bureau might at
a future date result in the establishment of facts worthy
of a further report.

（批：D.R. 23/6）
D.C. (Special Branch)
（签名：R Sharby D.S.）

8号：此人与 Brian Naidis 联手，曾于1935年在汉口试图促成臭名昭著的共产党人 Walden 的释放。（档案 D.6423, D.6704A, C.8255, E.1680）。

5. Alex Becker，32岁，拉脱维亚人，住拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1295号23室：有充分理由认为上述人员与 Alexander Leonidovich Pecker（别名 A.L.Becker）为同一人，系俄罗斯犹太人，生于1904年3月28日。据报 Pecker 在不同时期参与过多起与枪支销售有关的交易。1934年，Pecker 受雇于中国旅行社青岛分社，在此期间，他被青岛警方怀疑参与盗窃一枚钻戒，此外还涉嫌写恐吓信。1934年下半年回到上海后，寄宿管理处注意到他从威赛德路（Wayside Road）71号的一家寄宿处潜逃。最近，Pecker 因吸毒引起法国警方的注意。然而，他的外表掩盖了他对麻醉品的喜好，给大多数人的印象是一个极其世故且爱吹嘘的人。（档案 D.19）

虽然上述五人是根据工部局警务处档案记录，名单中唯一有不良记录的申请人，但其余人员似乎也不是特别正派的人选，看来对国际导游局的活动进行监视，可能会在未来发现值得进一步报告的事实。

（批：D.R. 23/6）
D.C. (特科)
（签名：R Sharby D.S.）

REPORT
Date June 10, 19 37.

Subject International Guides Bureau.

Made by D.S. Larby Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.S.

In connection with the attached correspondence emanating
from the International Guides Bureau, 180 Nanking Road, this
concern has now been established approximately two months.

Organized and to an extent financed by one, Mrs. Hanna
Durst, German, the wife of Mr. M.H.R. Durst who is a well known
constructional engineer of German nationality, and one who
possesses good connections with the local officials of the
Soviet Government, the firm numbers on its permanent staff
the following persons:-

1. Mrs. Hanna Durst, German, Managing Director.
2. Mr. F.E. Carneiro, Portuguese, Deputy Manager.
3. Mr. R.F. Remedios, Portuguese, Accountant.
4. Mr. J.M. Martin, Hungarian, clerical duties.
5. Mr. R.B. Foster-Kemp, British, no set duties.

In addition to the abovementioned five persons, Mr. J.H.
Rabbinowitz, German Jew, attorney-at-law, acts as the firm's
legal representative, while in addition it has been learned
that one, Dr. R.E. Kahn, German, barrister-at-law, has a
financial interest in the business, the extent of which, however
is not at present known.

Of the eight persons whose names have already been
mentioned, there is nothing in the records of the Municipal
Police to indicate that any of them are likely to use the
International Guides Bureau as a cloak for activities of a
criminal nature. Nevertheless, in view of the operations
in which it is proposed that this business will indulge,
it may not be amiss at this point to observe that the
reputation enjoyed by Mr. Foster-Kemp is not of the best,
particularly with regard to his relations with females.

（左侧批注：C.P.M. 11/6 D.C.(C)）
（印章：SPECIAL BRANCH 11 JUNE 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

关于附上的来自南京路180号国际导游局的信件，该机构成立至今约两个月。

该公司由德国人 Hanna Durst 女士组织并在一定程度上提供资金，她是 M.H.R. Durst 先生的妻子，Durst 先生是一位知名的德国籍建筑工程师，并与苏联政府的地方官员有着良好的关系，该公司的固定职员包括以下人员：-

1. Hanna Durst 女士，德国人，总经理。
2. F.E. Carneiro 先生，葡萄牙人，副经理。
3. R.F. Remedios 先生，葡萄牙人，会计。
4. J.M. Martin 先生，匈牙利人，文书工作。
5. R.B. Foster-Kemp 先生，英国人，无固定职责。

除上述五人外，德国犹太律师 J.H. Rabbinowitz 先生担任该公司的法律代表，此外还获悉，德国律师 R.E. Kahn 博士在该业务中拥有经济利益，但其具体程度目前尚不清楚。

在上述八人中，工部局警务处的记录中没有任何迹象表明他们会利用国际导游局作为从事犯罪活动的掩护。尽管如此，鉴于该业务拟开展的经营性质，在此指出 Foster-Kemp 先生的声誉并非最佳，特别是在他与女性的关系方面，或许并非多余。

An interview with Mrs. Durst, who appears to be a
woman of intelligence and according to the German Consulate
General, bears an untarnished reputation, indicated that the
main concern of the Bureau would be to provide a Guides
Service similar to that which is in operation in such cosmo-
politan cities as Berlin, New York and Paris. It is Mrs.
Durst's contention that, in a city such as Shanghai, particular-
ly when there are any of the bigger passenger vessels in port,
there are bound to be many women who would appreciate the
assistance of a man to enable them to see the sights and to
participate in the night life of the city. It is primarily
with this object in view, that the International Guides Bureau
will be operated. Escorts to assist ladies in their shopping
would also be provided and in this connection, Mrs. Durst
went to great pains to explain that any female escorts provided
by the Bureau would be personally selected from among those
individuals with whom she was herself acquainted and who,
moreover, were reputable members of the leading clubs in
Shanghai.
To revert to the male escorts, either Mr. Carneiro who
has served as a purser for some years on the ships operated
by Messrs. Butterfield and Swire, or Mrs. Durst would be
responsible for their selection. Mrs. Durst particularly
emphasised that the men so selected could not under any
circumstances be regarded as gigolos and cited as reasons
the instructions (copies attached) formulated by the Bureau,
which it must be admitted, if they are respected by the escorts,
should prevent any incidents of a questionable nature from
arising.

与杜斯特夫人（Mrs. Durst）的会谈显示，该局的主要关切是提供一种导游服务，类似于在柏林、纽约和巴黎等国际大都市中运营的服务。杜斯特夫人似乎是一位聪慧的女性，且据德国总领事馆称，她声誉清白。杜斯特夫人认为，在上海这样的城市，特别是当有大型客轮停靠港口时，必然会有许多女性希望得到男性的协助，以便游览景点并参与城市的夜生活。国际导游局（International Guides Bureau）的运营主要正是出于这一目的。该局还将提供协助女士购物的陪同人员；就此而言，杜斯特夫人煞费苦心地解释说，该局提供的任何女性陪同人员都将从她本人认识的个人中亲自挑选，而且这些人还是上海主要俱乐部中享有声誉的成员。
至于男性陪同人员，要么由曾在宝顺洋行（Butterfield and Swire）运营的船只上担任多年事务长的卡内罗先生（Mr. Carneiro），要么由杜斯特夫人负责挑选。杜斯特夫人特别强调，如此选出的男性在任何情况下都不能被视为男妓（gigolos），并引用了该局制定的指令（副本附后）作为理由；必须承认，如果陪同人员遵守这些指令，应能防止任何性质可疑的事件发生。

Concerning the charge for any escort supplied by the
Bureau, this is reckoned to amount to the sum of $15.00 for
a period of 2½ hours. For services performed during the
day time, the escort will receive one third of this sum while
the Bureau will claim the remaining two thirds. In the event
of the escort having to perform his duties during the night,
the scale of charges will remain the same but the proceeds will
be equally divided between the escort and his employers. In
addition to the above charges, the client will of course be
responsible for any expenses incurred during the period of the
escort's service.

With regard to the messenger service that the Bureau
proposes to operate, Mrs. Durst explained that this would
probably largely consist of the transportation of clients'
parcels, delivery of theatre tickets, flowers, medicines and
private messages. With reference to this latter service, viz.
the delivery of private messages, there would appear to be a
strong possibility that this service would be one which con-
travenes certain regulations promulgated by the Central Govern-
ment on behalf of the Chinese Post Office. This matter was there-
fore brought to the notice of the Director of Posts
Mr. A.M. Chapelain, who stated that as it was probable that
any breach of the regulations committed by the Bureau would be
due to ignorance, the Post Office would inform Mrs. Durst of
these regulations and of the most probable infringements thereof.
Mr. Chapelain promised furthermore to keep the undersigned
informed of all correspondence on this matter passing between
the Post Office and the International Guides Bureau and of any
additional action which the Post Office authorities might

关于该局提供的任何陪同人员的收费，预计金额为2½小时15.00元。对于白天提供的服务，陪同人员将获得该金额的三分之一，而该局将收取剩余的三分之二。如果陪同人员必须在夜间履行职责，收费标准保持不变，但收入将在陪同人员与其雇主之间平均分配。除上述费用外，客户当然需负责陪同人员服务期间产生的任何费用。

关于该局拟运营的信使服务，杜斯特夫人解释说，这可能主要包括运输客户的包裹、递送戏票、鲜花、药品和私人信件。关于后者，即递送私人信件，似乎很有可能会违反中国政府代表中国邮政局颁布的某些规定。因此，此事已提请邮政局局长A.M. Chapelain先生注意，他表示，鉴于该局任何违规行为可能是出于无知，邮政局将通知杜斯特夫人这些规定以及最可能出现的违规情况。Chapelain先生还承诺，随时向签署人通报邮政局与国际导游局之间关于此事的所有往来信函，以及邮政局当局随后认为有必要采取的任何额外行动。

RULES FOR GUIDES

1. An escort must never enter a client's apartment or hotel room and never be in any room with the client unless there are others present.

2. If a client gets drunk, the escort must call the head-waiter, place his/her partner in the care of the restaurant staff, and then leave. (In the case of a lady escort, a taxi will take her home at the I.G.B's expense).

3. The escort may nod to friends when on duty, but may never introduce his/her friends to clients or to enter into conversation with them while on duty.

4. In the case of a lady escort, the introduction will be only made in the premises of the Bureau, either by the Manager or the Sub-Manager.

5. The escort, when calling on a client merely announces himself at the client's address and sends in a card. When the client appears to meet him/her, they shake hands.

6. While taxiing to their first stop, the client will hand the escort an envelope containing cash for the expenses.

7. CARDINAL RULES FOR ESCORTS:

Don't get tight.
Don't get affectionate.
Don't get confidentially loquacious.

8. The escort agrees to confine his/her services exclusively to the International Guides Bureau, and not to enter into any negotiations with other enterprises of a similar nature, nor to conduct any private activities in that line.

9. It is understood that the escort shall not discuss any confidential matter regarding his/her services with the I.G.B.

10. Under no circumstances must the guide give clients his/her private address.

导游规则

1. 陪同人员绝不得进入客户的公寓或酒店房间，除非有其他人在场，否则绝不得与客户同处一室。

2. 如果客户喝醉，陪同人员必须呼叫领班，将其同伴交由餐厅工作人员照管，然后离开。（如果是女性陪同人员，出租车将送其回家，费用由国际导游局承担）。

3. 陪同人员在值班时可以向朋友点头致意，但绝不得在值班时将朋友介绍给客户，或与他们交谈。

4. 对于女性陪同人员，介绍只能在局内进行，由经理或副经理进行。

5. 陪同人员拜访客户时，仅在客户地址处通报姓名并递入名片。当客户出来见面时，双方握手。

6. 在乘车前往第一个地点的途中，客户将递给陪同人员一个装有现金的信封，用于支付费用。

7. 陪同人员的基本规则：

不要喝醉。
不要表现亲昵。
不要交浅言深。

8. 陪同人员同意将其服务 exclusively 限于国际导游局，不与类似性质的其他企业进行任何谈判，也不从事该领域的任何私人活动。

9. 据理解，陪同人员不得与国际导游局讨论有关其服务的任何机密事项。

10. 在任何情况下，导游不得向客户提供其私人地址。

局内进行，由经理或副
经理进行。

5. 陪同人员拜访客户时，仅在
客户地址处通报姓名并递入名片。当客户
出来见面时，双方握手。

6. 在乘车前往他们的
第一个地点的途中，客户将递给
陪同人员一个装有现金的信封，用于支付费用。

7. 陪同人员的基本规则：

不要喝醉。
不要表现亲昵。
不要交浅言深。

8. 陪同人员同意将其服务 exclusively 限于
国际导游局，不与类似性质的其他企业进行任何谈
判，也不从事该领域的任何私人活动。

9. 据理解，陪同人员不得讨论任何机密
事项，涉及其在国际导游局的服务。

10. 在任何情况下，导游不得向客户提供其私人
地址。

Translation of despatch to Council from the
5th Police Station of Hwaiyuan District,
Anhwei.
Dated 9th May 1931.
----
Abduction: Suspected case: Council asked to make certain
enquiries.
------------------
In the morning of the 4th instant, a man and a girl passed the
entrance of this Police Station; as their appearance roused suspicion,
they were closely interrogated, their dialects were different and their
statements confused. They were finally taken into custody for further
enquiries. The man stated :-
"I am a native of Yung Fei District, and my name is
Tung Tien-zei (童 殿 才). I sell pigs in Fengpu where
I bought the girl for $180 to marry my nephew."
The girl stated :-
"I am a native of Ningpo and nineteen years of age. My
name is Ching Ni-siao (金 二 小). Last winter I went with
my elder sister to reside in Shanghai, but have forgotten
the number of the house. My brother-in-law is a worker in a
carpenter's shop near the Tsao-ka-doo. Some days ago, I was
enticed to Fengpu by a man named Ching I-ming (金 益 明).
I do not know how he sold me, but I arrived here."
According to the girl's statement her brother-in-law Wong (王) is
a worker in a carpenter's shop near Tsao-ka-doo; it ought not to be
difficult to trace him. As Tsao-ka-doo is in the Council's jurisdic-
tion, the Council is asked to send officers to ascertain, near the
bridge, whether Ching Ni-siao, a relative of the carpenter Wong, has
disappeared. If the disappearance is a fact the Council is asked to
give the carpenter a document so that he may come to Hwaiyuan District.
If there is no such case the Council is asked to reply without delay.
(Signed & Chopped) Za Ching-i (石 經 一),
Inspector-in-charge
The girl does not know the name of her brother-in-law, but she knows
that the name of her nephew is Wong Fo-k'ong (王 福 康).
C. Kiene.
13 MAY 1931

安徽淮源区第五警察分局
致工部局的公函译文。
日期：1931年5月9日。
----
绑架：嫌疑案件：请工部局进行某些
调查。
------------------
本月4日上午，一男一女经过本警察局
门口；因其外貌引起怀疑，遂对其严加
盘问，二人方言不同，供词混乱。最终
将其拘留以作进一步调查。该男子称：-
“我是永飞区人，名叫
童殿才 (Tung Tien-zei)。我在凤浦卖猪，
在那里花了180元买下这个女孩，给我侄子做媳妇。”
该女孩称：-
“我是宁波人，十九岁。我叫
金二小 (Ching Ni-siao)。去年冬天我和
姐姐去上海居住，但忘记了门牌号。我姐夫
是曹家渡附近一家木匠店的工人。几天前，我被
一个叫金益明 (Ching I-ming) 的男人诱骗到凤浦。
我不知道他是怎么把我卖掉的，但我到了这里。”
根据女孩的陈述，她的姐夫王 (Wong) 是
曹家渡附近一家木匠店的工人；追踪他应该不
难。由于曹家渡在工部局管辖范围内，请工部局派员
在桥附近查明木匠王的亲属金二小是否
失踪。如果失踪属实，请工部局给木匠一份文件，以便他
能来淮源区。
如果没有此类案件，请工部局立即回复。
（签名并盖章）石经一 (Za Ching-i)，
主管督察
女孩不知道她姐夫的名字，但她知道
她侄子的名字是王福康 (Wong Fo-k'ong)。
C. Kiene.
1931年5月13日

Subject Loh Shiang Girl Guides' Service, 163 Fokien Road - providing girl
guides with motorcars.

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

The Loh Shiang Guides Service(樂鄉導社), situated
in the upper portion of 163 Fokien Road near Foochow Road
(Louza district), has an advertisement in the Hwa Mei Wan
Pao, dated February 3, 1938, stating that guides can be
obtained who are able to drive motor cars and for the con-
venience of patrons in travelling, the fee being $3 per
hour. A translation of the advertisement is attached.

The ordinary rate of charge for female guides obtained
from the Loh Shiang Guides Service is $1 per hour, but the
new rate, according to the advertisement, will be $3 per
hour, or $1 for 20 minutes, for one girl guide-chauffeur
and motor car. Consequently the $2 increase in the charge
per hour is presumably for the service of the motorcar, which
will be placed at the disposal of the patron together with
the girl, but these cars have private licence plates and are
not public hire car plates.

The proprietor of this service is one named Woo Miao
Kong(吳苗康), alias Woo Ying Poo(吳引波). He has at his
disposal two second-hand motorcars, which he bought sometime
ago, both bearing private car licence plates numbered 1519
and 3914 respectively. Licence No. 1519 was taken out in the
name of the proprietor, Woo Miao Kong who resides at No. 12,
Lane 119, Myburgh Road, while licence No. 3914 was taken out
in the name of Miss Woo Tien Zung(吳天人), one of the
girl guides employed by Woo Miao Kong, who gave her address
as No. 9, Lane 764 Haining Road. Miss Woo Tien Zung and
another girl guide named Bah Sih(白雪), who poses as
Woo Miao Kong's wife, have obtained owner driving permits

主题：福建路163号乐乡女子向导社 - 提供带汽车的女子向导。

由督察潘连璧 (Pan Lien-pih) 制作 由督察 C. Crawford 转发。

乐乡向导社 (Loh Shiang Guides Service)，位于
福建路163号靠近福州路的上段
（老闸区），在1938年2月3日的《华美晚报》上刊登广告，称可提供
会驾驶汽车的向导，为方便顾客出行，费用为每小时3元。广告译文附后。

从乐乡向导社获得的女向导通常收费标准为每小时1元，但根据广告，新的收费标准将是每小时3元，或每20分钟1元，包含一名女向导兼司机和一辆汽车。因此，每小时增加的2元费用大概是用于汽车服务，该车将与女向导一起供顾客使用，但这些汽车挂的是私人牌照，而非公共出租车牌照。

该社业主名为吴苗康 (Woo Miao Kong)，别名吴引波 (Woo Ying Poo)。他有两辆二手汽车可供支配，是不久前购买的，均挂私人汽车牌照，号码分别为1519和3914。牌照号1519是以业主吴苗康的名义登记的，他住在迈尔西爱路119弄12号，而牌照号3914是以吴天人小姐 (Miss Woo Tien Zung) 的名义登记的，她是吴苗康雇佣的女向导之一，其地址为海宁路764弄9号。吴天人小姐和另一位名叫白雪 (Bah Sih) 的女向导（自称是吴苗康的妻子）已获得车主驾驶执照

Sir,
With reference to report submitted May 31st., 1938 re action taken against Guide Bureaus operating within Rooms 318, 322, 324, 334 and 341, I beg to report that at 9 a.m. 1/6/38 P.S. 70 Tsuda brought to the Louza Station a Japanese subject named Mr. R. Fukue, Special Service Mission, residing Room 324 Oriental Hotel, Sincere Building who reported that following the raid conducted by the Police within Room 324 wherein three Chinese females were apprehended, one black cashmere jacket the property of him, R. Fukue was taken away by one named Tsang Tsau Dee who was apprehended from within Room 322. The jacket the complainant stated could be identified by two initials "M.Y." and further by the maker's name "Yuen Woo" stitched within the inside pocket. This jacket the complainant requested to be returned to him.
The complainant informed that arrangements would be made to remove this person from gaol and to return 2 p.m. 2/6/38 when by that time the prisoner would be at the station.
At 10 a.m. the above mentioned date the undersigned removed the prisoner to the station wearing the jacket bearing the marks of identification. Questioned he stated that his own jacket was at the cleaners and when apprehended he had no jacket to wear therefore after the leading the Police to Room 324 he took the jacket from a hook and put it on, with the intention of returning it upon his return to the room.
At 2 p.m. P.S. Tsuda and the complainant returned to the station and the jacket duly returned to him. The complainant

制作人：S. I. Varndell 转发人：老闸主管警官
先生，
关于1938年5月31日提交的关于对在318、322、324、334和341房间经营的向导局采取行动的報告，谨报告如下：1938年6月1日上午9点，巡佐70号津田将一名日本籍男子 R. Fukue 先生带到老闸分局，该男子隶属于特殊服务团，居住在先施大楼东方饭店324房间，他报告称，在警方突袭324房间并逮捕三名中国女性后，一件属于他 R. Fukue 的黑色开司米夹克被一名叫曾祖迪 (Tsang Tsau Dee) 的人拿走，此人是从322房间内被捕的。投诉人称，这件夹克可以通过两个首字母“M.Y.”以及缝在内袋里的制造商名称“Yuen Woo”来识别。投诉人要求归还这件夹克。
投诉人告知，将安排将此人的保释手续办好，并于1938年6月2日下午2点返回，届时囚犯将在分局。
当日上午10点，在下署名人将穿着带有识别标记夹克的囚犯带至分局。经讯问，他声称自己的夹克在洗衣店，被捕时没有夹克可穿，因此在带领警察前往324房间后，他从挂钩上取下夹克穿上，打算回到房间后归还。
下午2点，巡佐津田和投诉人回到分局，夹克 duly 归还给他。投诉人

Sir,
Referring to the subject of Guide Bureaus & Guide Girls,
premises No. 25 Swatow Road, formerly a Sing Song House, has
for some considerable time operated a Guide Bureau on a large
scale under the name of "Yang Kwei Fei (楊貴妃)," having on call
a total of 31 entertainers. The proprietor Tsang Zung Tuh (章仁德),
age 45 years, native of Ningpo, S/unemployed, residing on the
premises, was duly warned and failed to close.
At 8.40 p.m. 30/5/38, the undersigned and party visited the
premises and apprehended the proprietor and 12 others, who were
charged under Bye Law, 34. Keeping an Unlicenced Sing Song House
and Unlicenced entertainers, respectively.
In accordance with the court ruling, all were admitted to
bail to the amount of $15 each person. At the appointed time
all failed to appear at court, therefore each forfeited their
bail.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant.

National Daily News :- 28-5-38 (A.M.)

THE GIRL GUIDE ESTABLISHMENTS

There are several hundred girl guide
establishments in Shanghai. As the existence of such
establishments constitutes a serious menace to public
morals, the French Concession authorities are strictly
suppressing all such agencies. Many members of the girl
guide establishments located in the Dah Wu Hotel (大沪饭店)
and the Dah Fang Hotel (大方饭店) in French Concession
have been arrested and fined.
It is learned that the authorities of
the International Settlement have also decided to suppress
all such agencies within their jurisdiction and have
instructed the various police stations to enforce the
suppression. All girl guide establishments in the
International Settlement have been notified to suspend
operations as from date.

《国民日报》：1938年5月28日（上午版）

向导女机构

上海有数百家向导女机构。由于此类机构的存在
严重危害公共道德，法租界当局正严厉取缔所有此类 agency（机构）。
位于法租界大沪饭店和大方饭店的许多向导女机构成员
已被逮捕并罚款。
据悉，公共租界当局也已决定在其辖区内
取缔所有此类机构，并已指示各警署执行取缔工作。
公共租界内的所有向导女机构均已收到通知，
自即日起停止营业。

Search Warrant No.0019 raided the above mentioned premises
and discovered within 2 rooms a total of 10 persons,
consisting of 3 males and 7 females, as menti)ned in sheet No.1.
Enquiries made, it was ascertained that the 5th to 10th
accused had assembled themselves for the purpose of being called
to various hotels and lodging houses for the benifit of guests
who desired sexual intercourse, and each girl on receiving
a call would be given a printed card, which would be filled in
and handed to them by the 1st accused, who provides the rooms,
with telephones for that purpose.
A charge of $1.00 per call per hour is made by the 1st
accused, and is divided up as follows:-
40 cents to the room boy or attendant of the hotel or
lodging house who put in the call.
30 cents to the 1st accused
30 cents to the girl answering the call.
This charge is solely for the calling of the girl and if
the guest desires sexual intercourse and the girl is willing,
it will take place within the room of either the hotel or
lodging house and the guest will pay what he thinks fit, and
the earnings is claimed to be taken by the girl.
This type of prostitution is conducted under a cloak,
what is known as a "Girl Guide Bureau". During the past year
numerous other places have sprung up over the Settlement and the
French Concession, and numerous anonymous complaints have been
received from time to time, wherein a person having alleged to
have called these kind of girls, and after having had sexual in
intercourse, have been compelled to part with far more money

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Zung Kung Dee
native of Soochow taken by me Sub Inspector Varndell.
at Louza Stn. on the 8-8-37 and translated by Clerk Pao Ti Yi

My name is Zung Kung Dee, age 17 years, native of Soochow
Single, female, residing No. 10 Koh S Lee, Elgin Road, together
with Dong Kwei Shih. During the past 5 months, I have been
living on and off at Lane 27 House No.16 Yunnan Road, in a
room situated on the 1st floor, which place is a Guides Bureau,
conducted by one named, Zee Ching Yue, native of Soochow.

Prior to residing at Elgin Road, I was at Soochow, with my
mother, named Zung Chao Pao, age 60 years, native of Soochow,
my father deceased 2 years.

About one year ago, I came to Shanghai for the purpose
of becoming a dancing girl, but owing to the bad state of
business, I was later induced by Dong Kwei Shih to join her in
the business as a guide, I consented and came with her to Lane
27, House No. 16 Yunnan Road.

Our method of obtaining business is on the following lines,
a telephone is installed, a message will be received from any
Hotel or lodging house, (where we are registered) through the
room boy that a guest requires a guide, a printed card is
filled in by Zee Ching Yue, and we are sent to the place of
calling.

According to rules, the time limit is one hour and a
charge of $1.00 is made, The guest who requires us will pay
the amount, which is divided up as follows:- 40 cents to the
room boy or attendant who puts in the call, 30 cents to Zee
Ching Yue and 30 cents to the guide.

If the guest desires sexual intercourse and the guide is
willing, it will take place therein the room occupied by the
guest, and the guest will pay the guide what he thinks fit.
The amount obtained is solely our own. Altogether I have
co-habited with 5 guests, who have called me in the manner
prescribed.

Finger printed. Zung Kung Dee

以下为苏州籍女子 Zung Kung Dee（音译）的供词，由我，副督察 Varndell，于1937年8月8日在老闸捕房录取，并由职员 Pao Ti Yi（音译）翻译。

我叫 Zung Kung Dee（音译），17岁，苏州人，未婚，女性，与 Dong Kwei Shih（音译）同住爱而近路 (Elgin Road) 葛司礼里 (Koh S Lee) 10号。在过去5个月里，我断断续续住在云南路27弄16号二楼的一个房间里，该处是一个“向导社”，由一名叫 Zee Ching Yue（音译）的苏州人经营。

在居住爱而近路之前，我和母亲 Zung Chao Pao（音译，60岁，苏州人）住在苏州，父亲已于两年前去世。

大约一年前，我来上海打算当舞女，但由于生意不景气，后来被 Dong Kwei Shih（音译）诱劝加入她做向导的生意，我同意了并随她来到云南路27弄16号。

我们要招揽生意的方法如下：安装了一部电话，通过茶房收到任何旅馆或寄宿舍（我们已登记注册）的消息，称有客人需要向导，Zee Ching Yue（音译）会填写一张印刷卡片，然后我们将被派往应召地点。

按照规定，时限为一小时，收费1.00元。需要我们的客人支付这笔费用，分配方式如下：- 打电话的茶房或侍者得40分，Zee Ching Yue（音译）得30分，向导得30分。

如果客人希望发生性关系且向导愿意，便会在客人占用的房间内发生，客人会支付他认为合适的金额给向导。所得金额完全归我们自己所有。总计我与5名以规定方式应召的客人发生过同居关系。

按指印。 Zung Kung Dee（音译）

Sir,
With reference to the attached subject, the undersigned
has since the formation of these so called bureaus, made a
careful study of matters pertaining to same, and from time to
time have frequented hotels and lodging houses, wherein
appointments have been made between guide girls and occupants
of rooms of the addresses concerned, appointments being made
usually by means of a telephone call.
Upon prospective clients of the guide girl bureau being
questioned, it has been learnt that they have invariably been
approached by the hotel or lodging house staff and asked if
they desire the services of a guide girl for pleasure, an
occupant of the room having assented to the above suggestion or
expressed willingness for same, a guide girl is immediately
called by the hotel staff and attends the room concerned.
From other clients it has been learnt that they are old
acquaintances of some particular guide girl and have therefore
requested the hotel or lodging house staff to request her
attendance.
Prior to the outbreak of the present hostilities, hotels,
and lodging houses did not harbour these bureaus, therefore
the proprietor or intended proprietor of a "Guide Girl" Bureau
would rent a part or section of a ordinary dwelling house, but
when curfew regulations were imposed, it resulted in the guide
girls not being able to proceed out of the premises during the
hours of curfew.
The above eventually resulted in such bureaus or establish-
ments closing down their premises and moving into hotels or

客户多次召唤某一名特定的向导女后感到厌倦，于是从另一家社团或中介雇佣了另一名向导女，前者得知此事后，心生不满，于是纠集几名流氓分子，在该女孩的陪同下，以威胁和恐吓手段向客户勒索或试图勒索一定数额的钱款，声称若不从，将以强奸的虚假指控对他提起诉讼，由该向导女作为原告。
众所周知，向导女通常是为了不道德目的而聚集，而且她们所依附和运作的名称发展到了如此庞大的数量，以至于随着时间的推移，似乎将变得无法控制。
具报人曾两次尝试在特区地方法院对上述此类以不道德目的聚集向导女的社团取得定罪，但尽管提交的证据确凿，每次仅给予警告。

From the above it will be understood this employment
(guide girls) is nearly definitely prostitution under a cloak
of feigned respectability and that possibly as a result of
licensing, the immoral practices might increase, the organiza-
tion or bureaus have increased to such an extent that it appears
the time is imminent when steps should be taken to approve and
licence the bureaus and guide girl employees on the suggested
lines and so enable the premises concerned to be visited and
supervised by the Police on lines similar to those as at
present in force regarding hotels, lodging houses and Sing Song
Houses.

By the above supervision it would prevent gross
irregularities and create the very necessary and required
impression upon the proprietors of the bureau and employees
alike, that they are not immune from being prosecuted by the
S.M.Police for any behaviour and actions contrary to the
suggested licence conditions under which they would operate.

社团、中介或机构的业主，另一张发给每位受雇的向导女，此外，每位向导女还必须拥有一张身份证明卡，在受雇期间必须随时随身携带，

建议的业主执照样本上列出的向导人数仅记录雇员为1至10人，但这并不意味着每个社团必须雇佣该数量的向导，划定这一数字仅是因为已知有几个社团雇佣了该数量的向导女。

由此可知，这种职业（向导女）几乎肯定是在伪装的体面外衣下的卖淫行为，而且作为发照的结果，不道德行为可能会增加，这些组织或社团已经发展到如此程度，看来采取步骤按照建议的方针批准并发放社团和向导女雇员执照的时刻已迫在眉睫，从而使有关场所能够像目前针对旅馆、寄宿舍和书寓 (Sing Song Houses) 实施的方针一样，接受警方的访问和监督。

通过上述监督，将防止严重的违规行为，并在社团业主和雇员心中留下非常必要和所需的印象，即他们并非免于因任何违反建议执照条件下运营的行为和行动而受到上海公共租界警务处的起诉。

May 10th, 1938.

Commissioner of Police.

Licensing of Guide Bureau and Guides.

In view of the Council's policy regarding the licensing
of prostitutes and brothels, I am of the opinion that the
proposed licensing of any undertaking which tends to cloak
prostitution would be rejected by them.

The "Guides Bureaus" are apparently only concerns
who procure females for immoral purposes for their clients,
and I think it could only be regarded by the Council as the
"thin edge of the wedge" to licence these bureaus and guides,
when the Police know perfectly well they are merely a cloak
for conducting clandestine prostitution. The Police have the
power where evidence is available to prosecute persons concerned
in conducting these Bureaus when they commit offences
against morality, and I am of the opinion that the licensing
of these concerns would not have the desired effect of
controlling or curtailing the use of these females for
immoral purposes, and the only benefit gained would be an
added source of revenue to the Council. The problem is
difficult one, but until the Council change their policy in
regard to the licensing of brothels and prostitutes or
segregating special areas for this purpose, I do not think
the proposals forwarded by Sub Inspector Varndell would be
acceptable. There is also the view that the Council may have
no legal right to license such bureaus and guides.

G. Gilbert.
Officer in charge Divs.

I agree. If these bureaus are merely prostitute
agencies the Council could not license them. If they are

向导介绍所及向导的执照发放问题。

鉴于工部局关于妓女和妓院执照发放的政策，我认为，任何倾向于掩盖卖淫活动的经营项目的拟议执照发放都将被工部局拒绝。

“向导介绍所”显然只是为客户 procuring（拉皮条/提供）女性以供不道德目的使用的机构，我认为，既然警方完全清楚这些介绍所仅仅是进行秘密卖淫的幌子，工部局只能将给这些介绍所和向导发放执照视为“楔子的薄端”（即打开缺口的开端）。在有证据的情况下，警方有权起诉经营这些介绍所并犯有妨害风化罪行的相关人员，我认为，给这些机构发放执照并不能达到控制或减少将这些女性用于不道德目的的预期效果，唯一的好处只是增加了工部局的收入来源。这是一个棘手的问题，但在工部局改变其关于妓院和妓女执照发放或为此目的划定特定区域的政策之前，我认为副巡官 Varndell 提交的提案是不可接受的。此外还有一种观点认为，工部局可能没有法律权利给此类介绍所和向导发放执照。

G. Gilbert.

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury
00997
Police Planning Moral
Drive; Initial Action
Centers On Girl Guides
War On Gangs Engaged In Women Trafficking
Being Intensified; 500 Bureaus Employing
10,000 Girls Exist In Louza Area
Chinese Court Endorses Campaign

An intensive drive against immoral establishments in the International Settlement is being planned by the Shanghai Municipal Police, it is reliably learned today. At the same time, war on organized gangs engaged in trafficking in women will be intensified.

The initial action will be directed against the so-called "girl guide bureaux" which are more or less camouflaged brothels according to a police officer. There are some 500 such shady establishments in the Louza district alone, it is alleged. The number of girls employed in the bureaux is estimated at 10,000 each house harboring between 15 and 20 girls.

Refugee Influx
The abnormal increase of houses of ill-fame is due to the overcrowding of the Settlement area since the heavy influx of war victims. The present white slave traffic situation is such that it constitutes a grave menace to the entire community, it is explained. Hundreds of innocent women and girls are daily falling prey to the city's sinister elements. The number of girls becoming inmates of houses of ill-fame is alarming, according to the officer. Another factor responsible for the present deplorable situation is the large number of gangster elements who have lately turned to the more lucrative white slave traffic.

Vice Squads Alert
The police are today keeping an alert eye on women traffickers. Vice squads are working overtime now in breaking up organised gangs. Unlicensed women are being rounded up by the scores daily by the police. Since the beginning of the year, no less than 30 well-organised bands of traffickers were broken up despite the fact that the police work was hampered by the unwillingness on the part of the victims to co-operate with them.

While it is almost impossible to cope with all the existing establishments at one time, the police will deal drastically with any bureau that come to their attention in the course of the planned campaign. The big police drive will drastically cut down the number of shady girl escort bureaux, it is expected.

First Raid Made
The first successful blow dealt to a girl guide bureau since the police took to the warpath was on Thursday, when a raid staged under the leadership of Sub-Inspector M. J. Vanzetti, resulted in a raid at Noon 611 in Yangtszepoo Road on Kinshan Road, one of the biggest Chinese houses for men and women, including the proprietor of the bureau, were taken into custody. The raid marks the first victory given to all operators of illegal establishments.

The owner of the joint and those connected with it were convicted on charges of assembling women for immoral purposes in the First Special District Court the following day. This is the first time the court has fully endorsed the police action against girl guide bureaux. Hitherto the court has been lenient with operators of such establishments, invariably letting them off with a caution. Judge Sung, in convicting the prisoners, stated that hereafter all establishments engaged in immoral practices will be subject to severe measures governing unlicensed houses of prostitution. The escort service in the hotel was automatically closed.

Sample Testimony
In this case, the police work was made much easier as one of the inmates gave full evidence against her abductors. In addition the police obtained a concrete proof of the bureau having forced the girl to prostitution. The victim, a 18-year-old girl, when questioned by the police. It was disclosed that fancy women and girls were first enticed to the bureau and then forced to submit to a life of shame. The girls are promised 10 per cent of the earnings, but actually a girl is lucky to receive 25 per cent of gross earnings, according to the girl's testimony in court.

Practically every girl guide bureau is a brothel in disguise, according to Sub-Inspector Vanzetti who has been responsible for the breaking up of more than 30 organised gangs of traffickers in women since January. It is no exaggeration to say that 90 per cent of the existing bureaux are houses of ill-repute.

Shanghai Bureau Hit
Because of the increasing number of girl escort bureaux, the business of the Chinese police and other bodies is greatly affected. Today practically every street or lodging house has at least one or two bureaux which maintain numerous girls within the hotel serving the sing-song girls in the café. It is said. Prior to the war there were some 300 sing-song houses in the Louza area. The present number is not more than 100 according to one who has made a study.

White Slave Houses Pay
Heavy Tax. The question arises as to how the girl guide bureaux are able to pay the S.M.C. taxes if they do not operate as brothels. It is said that for a nominal fee the Sing-song houses pay the money received from the girls' earnings to at least $500 monthly to the authorities.

Trafficking Increases
There has been also an increase in the case of trafficking in females since the cessation of hostilities in Shanghai. Hundreds of girls were lured to brothels in various parts of Shanghai and other cities such as Tientsin, Hankow and Nanking, according to the police. The girls are forced to such places by gangsters and kept in Old prewar establishments for them. These latter months, girls from the vile dens brought with them horrible tales of an indescribable life.

It is believed that the police will eventually curb activity in girl guide bureaux and thus break up the vicious circle of the white slave traffic. The Shanghai Municipal Council and the police are determined to put an end to this evil. The recent raid is only the beginning of a comprehensive campaign to wipe out the white slave traffic in Shanghai.

《上海晚邮报与信使报》
00997
警方策划道德整肃行动；初步行动
聚焦于“女向导”
打击从事妇女贩卖的帮派之战
正在 intensified；老闸地区存在500家雇用
10,000名女子的机构
中国法院支持该运动

据今日可靠消息，上海公共租界工部局警务处正计划对国际租界内的不道德场所进行严厉整肃。与此同时，针对从事妇女贩卖的有组织帮派的打击行动也将加强。

据一名警官称，初步行动将针对所谓的“女向导局”（girl guide bureaux），这些机构或多或少是伪装起来的妓院。据称，仅老闸（Louza）地区就有约500家此类 shady 场所。据估计，这些机构雇用的女子人数达10,000人，每家机构容纳15至20名女子不等。

难民涌入

由于战争受害者大量涌入导致租界区域过度拥挤，声名狼藉的场所数量异常增加。据解释，目前的白奴贸易形势已构成对整个社区的严重威胁。每天仍有数百名无辜妇女和女孩沦为城市中邪恶势力的牺牲品。据该警官称，沦为妓院囚徒的女孩数量令人震惊。造成当前可悲局面的另一个因素是，大量黑帮分子最近转向了利润更丰厚的白奴贸易。

扫黄组保持警戒

警方今日正密切关注人口贩子。扫黄组目前正加班加点瓦解有组织帮派。警方每天成批逮捕无执照女子。自今年年初以来，尽管受害者的不配合阻碍了警方工作，但仍有不少于30个组织严密的人口贩卖团伙被瓦解。

虽然几乎不可能一次性取缔所有现存的此类场所，但在计划的行动中，警方将对任何引起其注意的机构采取严厉措施。预计这次大规模的警方行动将大幅减少可疑的女伴游机构数量。

首次突袭实施

自警方采取强硬手段以来，对女向导局成功实施的首次打击发生在周四。由副督察 M. J. Vanzetti 领导的突袭行动，在杨树浦路（Yangtszepoo Road）与金山路（Kinshan Road）交界处的 Noon 611 号展开，这是一家大型男女混杂场所，包括该机构老板在内的多人被拘留。此次突袭标志着对所有非法场所经营者的一次胜利。

次日，该场所老板及相关人员因聚集妇女从事不道德目的之罪名在第一特区法院被判有罪。这是法院首次完全支持警方针对女向导局的行动。此前，法院对此类场所的经营者一直从宽处理，通常仅予以警告便放行。宋法官（Judge Sung）在对犯人定罪时表示，此后所有从事不道德行为的场所都将受到针对无执照妓院的严厉措施管辖。该酒店内的伴游服务随即被关闭。

证词样例

在此案中，由于一名被拘禁者提供了对其绑架者的完整证词，警方工作得以大大简化。此外，警方获得了该机构强迫女孩卖淫的确凿证据。这名18岁的受害者在接受警方询问时透露，年轻貌美的女子和女孩首先被诱骗至该机构，随后被迫过上羞耻的生活。根据该女孩在法庭上的证词，女孩们被承诺可获得收入的10%，但实际上，能拿到总收入的25%就算幸运了。

据负责自一月以来瓦解了30多个有组织妇女贩卖团伙的副督察 Vanzetti 称，实际上每个女向导局都是伪装的妓院。毫不夸张地说，现存机构中有90%是声名狼藉的场所。

上海机构受打击

由于女伴游机构数量不断增加，中国警方及其他机构的工作受到极大影响。据说，如今 practically 每条街道或旅馆都至少有一两家机构，它们在酒店内供养众多女孩，为咖啡馆里的歌女提供服务。战前，老闸地区约有300家歌女屋。据一位研究者称，目前的数量不超过100家。

白奴场所缴纳
高额税款。这就引出了一个问题：如果女向导局不作为妓院运营，它们如何能够支付工部局（S.M.C.）的税款？据说，歌女屋以名义上的费用，将女孩收入中至少每月500美元的钱款交给当局。

贩卖活动增加

自上海停战以来，女性人口贩卖案件也有所增加。据警方称，数百名女孩被诱骗至上海各地以及天津、汉口和南京等其他城市的妓院。这些女孩被黑帮分子强迫送往这些地方，并被关押在战前的旧场所中。近几个月来，从这些肮脏巢穴中带出的女孩们讲述了难以形容的可怕生活经历。

人们相信，警方最终将遏制女向导局的活动，从而打破白奴贸易的恶性循环。上海公共租界工部局和警方决心终结这一罪恶。最近的突袭只是铲除上海白奴贸易的全面运动的开端。

page_data.en:
01024

GIRL GUIDE BUREAUS

THE Shanghai Municipal Police has embarked upon what
may be called a crusade against vice. It has closed a
number of the girl guide bureaus and has caused the con-
victions of their operators.

The action taken by the police is indeed commendable.
It has at last awakened to a situation which is a serious
disgrace to this community. On this subject a section of
the press has been quite outspoken, and it is to be hoped
that further closures will be effected and convictions obtain-
ed of the culprits concerned.

The evil which has come from the girl guide bureaus
will not be effectively controlled unless the authorities in
the French Concession will emulate the example set by the
Shanghai Municipal Police. Otherwise, the bureaus may be
removed to the Concession and may there carry on their
nefarious traffic in women as usual.

It is reported that some 10,000 women are employed by
the 500 bureaus. Now that the bureaus are being closed,
the problem arises as to how to provide employment of the
women. Will they be saved from their exploiters only to
fall into worse hands, or will they be given a chance to
earn a respectable living? We wonder.

S.1.
DR
3/7
page_data.zh:
01024

女向导局

上海公共租界工部局警务处已着手开展一场可称为反罪恶十字军东征的行动。它关闭了一批女向导局，并使其经营者被判有罪。

警方的行动确实值得称赞。它终于觉醒，认识到这是一种令本社区蒙受严重耻辱的局面。在此问题上，部分报刊直言不讳，希望能进一步实施关闭行动，并使相关罪犯被判有罪。

除非法租界当局效仿上海公共租界工部局警务处树立的榜样，否则源自女向导局的罪恶将无法得到有效控制。否则，这些机构可能会搬迁至法租界，并在那里照常进行其邪恶的妇女贩卖活动。

据报道，500家机构雇用了约10,000名妇女。既然这些机构正在被关闭，如何为这些妇女提供就业的问题便随之出现。她们是从剥削者手中获救，却落入更糟糕的人手中，还是有机会获得体面的生计？我们对此表示怀疑。

S.I.
DR
3/7

page_data.en:
0106

Moral Drive
THE EXPECTED big SMP
campaign against the so-called
"girl escort bureaus" got under
way in earnest last night when
between 8 and 11.30 o'clock, a vice
squad from the Louza station
under the leadership of Sub-In-
spector M. H. Varndell raided no
less than five bureaus and arrest-
ed 12 conductors of these es-
tablishments and 22 girl escorts
(called girl guides here).
This is the biggest raid carried
out in the Louza dis-
trict on the girl
guide bureaus since
the SMP launched
a "moral drive" last
week. Similar raids
are expected to be
made everyday in the
downtown area.
Giving full encouragement to
the police action in an effort to
exterminate vice dens in the
Settlement, the First Special
District Court this morning meted
out jail terms to the joints.
Hitherto the owners of such
bureaus were only cautioned and
released, and conductors of bro-
thels were subjected to fines only.
All the girls were today fined,
however.
Getting into action at 8 o'clock,
the vice squad swooped down on
the Yang Kwei Fei (named after
a royal concubine) at 25 Swatow
Road. This es-
tablishment has no
less than 31 girls,
most of whom were
out at the time of
the raid. Five male
and one woman operator of this
joint and seven girls were hauled
into the van and taken to the
station where each of them was
bailed out for $15.
Within half an hour the police visited
the Oriental Hotel in the Sincere build-
ing on Nanking Road and raided room
318 where two men and five girls
were taken into custody. The two men
were given 10 days detention today
while the girls were fined $5 each. The
joint was at the same time ordered
closed. The charges brought against
them were those of operating unlicensed
sing-song houses and entertaining guests
without licenses, in view of the fact
that lack of concrete evidence prevents
the police from bringing other charges.
Simultaneously Room 334 in the
same hotel was raided. Here the
police nabbed a man and two girl
entertainers. The
man was sentenced
to 10 days while the
girls were fined.
Rooms 322 and 324
also came to the
police attention. The
owner of the joint,
Tsang Tseu-dee, claimed Japanese
citizenship and a Japanese con-
stable was summoned to the scene.
He later turned out to be a Chin-
ese. Tsang was given two weeks
in jail today. Three girls arrested
were fined $5 each."
Going to the third floor, the
police arrested two males and five
girls in Room 431. The conductors
were given 10 days detention and
the girls were fined today. A total
of 14 men and women were round-
ed up by the Louza station unit
last night. Seventeen prostitutes
were also rounded up by the same
party.
page_data.zh:
0106

道德整肃行动

预期的工部局警务处（SMP）针对所谓“女伴游局”的大规模行动昨晚正式开始。在8点至11点30分之间，由副督察 M. H. Varndell 领导的老闸分局扫黄组突袭了不少于五家机构，逮捕了12名这些场所的管理者和22名女伴游（此处称为女向导）。

这是自上周工部局警务处发起“道德整肃行动”以来，在老闸地区对女向导局进行的最大规模突袭。预计市中心区域每天都会进行类似的突袭。

第一特区法院今早对这些场所判处监禁，以全力支持警方消灭租界内罪恶窝点的行动。此前，此类机构的老板仅被警告后释放，妓院管理者仅被处以罚款。然而，所有女孩今日均被罚款。

扫黄组于8点开始行动，突袭了位于汕头路25号的“杨贵妃”（以一位皇家妃嫔命名）。该机构拥有不少于31名女孩，突袭发生时大多数女孩外出。该场所的五名男性经营者和一名女性经营者以及七名女孩被带上警车并送往警局，每人以15美元保释。

半小时内，警方走访了位于南京路先施大楼内的东方饭店，突袭了318房间，两名男子和五名女孩被拘留。两名男子今日被判处拘留10天，女孩们各被罚款5美元。该场所同时被勒令关闭。鉴于缺乏确凿证据使警方无法提出其他指控，对他们的指控是无执照经营歌女屋和无执照招待客人。

与此同时，同一酒店的334房间也遭到突袭。警方在此抓获了一名男子和两名女艺人。该男子被判处10天监禁，女孩们被罚款。322和324房间也引起了警方的注意。该场所老板曾子迪（Tsang Tseu-dee，音译）声称拥有日本国籍，一名日本巡捕被召至现场。后来发现他是中国人。曾今日被判处两周监禁。被捕的三名女孩各被罚款5美元。

前往三楼，警方在431房间逮捕了两名男子和五名女孩。管理者被判处10天拘留，女孩们今日被罚款。老闸分局小队昨晚共围捕了14名男女。同一小组还围捕了17名妓女。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury. 15 JAN 1939

Bogus Court Official
AN INDIGENT clerk employed
by the Yung Hwa Glass Shop
at 367-9 Fokien Road named Ong
Ying-sung, 32, had the mistaken
idea that he could fool people by
masquerading as an official to the
First Special District Court.
Posing as such, Ong is alleged to
have called a girl guide named
Wong Fi-A from the Anna Girl
Guide Service and raped the girl
on December 13 at the Great
China Hotel. Ong was charged
with offense against public moral-
ity today and was remanded for
one week. He admitted his crime.
A representative from M. Paul
Premet's law office represented
the girl.

《上海晚邮报与信使报》 1939年1月15日

假冒法院官员
一名受雇于福建路367-9号永华玻璃店的贫困职员，名叫翁英松（Ong Ying-sung），32岁，产生了一个错误的念头，以为可以通过伪装成第一特区地方法院的官员来欺骗世人。据称，翁某以此身份，从安娜女向导服务社召唤了一名名为黄菲亚（Wong Fi-A）的女向导，并于12月13日在大华饭店强奸了该女孩。翁某今日被控犯有妨害风化罪，并被还押候审一周。他承认了自己的罪行。
保罗·普雷梅（Paul Premet）律师事务所的一名代表代表该女孩出庭。

Ta Chung Daily News publishes the following article :-
PROSTITUTION BY GUIDE ESTABLISHMENT GIRLS
30 JUNE 1938
(PM)

The Shanghai First Special District Citizens'
Federation, in a petition to the Shanghai Municipal Council,
points out that the girls of guide establishments are
openly carrying out prostitution in hotels throughout the
night. This is harmful to young men. It requests the
Council to suppress them.
It is true that girls of guide establishments
are doing business in local hotels throughout the night.
The promoters of girl guide establishments are smart men;
they understand their business. Wealthy young men, who
send for guide establishment girls, do so for pleasure.
The girls engaged by guide establishments realize this
very well and have to sacrifice their beauty and to place it
at the disposal of others. Cases of prostitution
throughout the night have thus taken place.
The cost of having a guide establishment girl
for one night is very cheap. For instance, in the case
of a prostitute, one has to spend $5 or $6 before one can
sleep with her, but when one sends for a guide establishment
girl, one can achieve one's object for half the price.
That is why the girl guide establishments are doing so
good business, thereby seriously affecting the business
of the prostitutes who visit hotels.
The girl guide establishments are more harmful
to the youth than prostitutes. It is hoped that the S.M.C.
will strictly suppress the girl guide establishments.

《大钟日报》刊登如下文章：
向导社女孩卖淫
1938年6月30日
（下午）

上海第一特区市民联合会在向上海公共租界工部局提交的请愿书中指出，向导社的女孩在旅馆中整夜公开从事卖淫活动。这对青年男子有害。它请求工部局予以取缔。
的确，向导社的女孩在当地旅馆中整夜做生意。女子向导社的发起人是精明的人；他们懂行。召唤向导社女孩的富有青年是为了寻欢作乐。受雇于向导社的女孩对此非常清楚，不得不牺牲自己的美貌，任人摆布。因此发生了整夜卖淫的案件。
雇佣一名向导社女孩过夜的费用非常便宜。例如，对于妓女，一个人必须花费5或6元才能与其同床共枕，但当一个人召唤向导社女孩时，只需一半的价格就能达到目的。这就是为什么女子向导社生意如此兴隆，从而严重影响了那些出入旅馆的妓女的生意。
女子向导社对青年的危害比妓女更大。希望上海公共租界工部局严格取缔女子向导社。

事由：女向导场所。

呈报人：副督察 Varndell。转呈人：[签名]

先生：

关于随附的1940年1月20日《大美报》（Ta Mei Pao）刊登文章的译文，该文提及租界内各场所的娱乐业；文中称，尽管工部局已发布命令禁止在旅馆内设立女向导场所及由其分发小册子，但本人谨此报告，当局正竭尽全力铲除各类旅馆和寄宿寓所内此类场所的聚集现象。

1937年战事爆发时，由于宵禁限制，娱乐业受到极大影响。因此，各场所经营者想方设法，尽其所能维持经营。唯一的解决办法是：关闭其原有场所，搬迁至各类旅馆和寄宿寓所，并以一种被称为“向导与女子伴游”的新型娱乐形式，按类似方式联合经营。

警方曾多次试图通过以“滋扰”罪名指控经营者和陪侍人员，来阻止此类场所在旅馆等地经营。但法庭裁定未构成滋扰，判决结果为“无罪”。

直到1938年5月27日，警方能够提出具体案例，表明这些场所在无执照的情况下作为歌厅

January 20,1940. Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Bao :-

THE GIRL GUIDE ESTABLISHMENTS IN SHANGHAI.

In the past, the former Shanghai City
Government strictly prohibited the use of obscene
expressions by massage houses, etc. in any kind of
literature.

On the outbreak of local hostilities, this
order was no longer observed. Furthermore, girl guide
establishments have sprung up like mushrooms and they have
even resorted to open propaganda.

Despite the order issued by the S.M.C.
prohibiting girl guide establishments in hotels and the
distribution of pamphlets by them, this corrupt practice
has been revived as agents have been sent to hotels and
restaurants where they tout business openly.

The suppression of any growing wave of
immorality is always a difficult matter.

Shanghai Daily News (上海日報), a mosquito paper, publishes
the following article :-    12 JULY 1938 PM

THE GIRL GUIDE ESTABLISHMENTS

Ever since the appearance of girl
guide establishments in Shanghai, many young decent
girls have been victimized and numerous promising young
men have gone astray. Such establishments are a menace
to public morals; they constitute a source of social
evils.

The action of the Settlement
authorities in suppressing such establishments is
therefore beyond criticism. However, some consideration
should likewise be given to the consequences that may
arise from this suppression, because once the Girl
guide agencies are forced to close, the guide girls
will unquestionably fall back to their old profession
as a means to earn a living and private prostitutes
will become more numerous.

Therefore, in the opinion of the writer
of this article, for the time being the Settlement
authorities should not enforce a strict suppression of
girl guide establishments but should place a limit on
the number of such agencies pending an improvement in
local conditions. In this way, some of the evils arising
out of the existence of such agencies can be removed.
The above suggestion is published
herewith for consideration by the Settlement authorities.

“蚊子报”《上海日报》（Shanghai Daily News）刊登
以下文章：    1938年7月12日 下午

女向导场所

自从上海出现女向导场所以来，许多
年轻良家女子受害，无数有为青年误入歧途。
此类场所危害公共道德；是社会弊端的源头。

因此，租界当局镇压此类场所的行动
无可非议。然而，同样应考虑这种镇压可能带来的
后果，因为一旦女向导中介所被迫关闭，
向导女孩无疑会重操旧业以谋生，
私娼数量将会增加。

因此，本文作者认为，暂时而言，租界当局
不应严厉镇压女向导场所，而应在当地状况
改善之前，限制此类中介机构的数量。通过这种方式，
可以消除因这些中介机构存在而产生的一些弊端。
以上建议特此刊登，供租界当局考虑。

?
